Jane — please find our consolidated deliverables attached. Summary of what's included: 

1) Completed questionnaire: answers are inline in Halo_IAM_Questionnaire_v2_filled.xlsx (we returned the original workbook with responses and references).

2) SCIM mapping: redwood_scim_mapping_template.csv includes default attributes and examples for mapping orgUnit -> urn:custom:halo:orgUnit and costCenter -> urn:custom:halo:costCenter. We also included two example user rows (employee and contractor).

3) Admin role matrix: admin_role_matrix.pdf describes roles, permissions, delegation model, and the 2-person approval flow for super-admin escalations.

4) SAML/OIDC summary evidence: evidence_saml_oidc_summary.pdf contains sample IdP metadata, recommended assertion mapping, and a screenshot of an SSO test (successful assertion with NameID and groups).

Notes / clarifications:
- Group-to-role provisioning: supported via SCIM group membership sync. We can map SCIM groups to Redwood roles; include mapping in the CSV under the groupMap column.
- SCIM write operations: we support PATCH and PUT; bulk provisioning via SCIM import is supported for initial syncs.
- Assertion attributes: we recommend sending given_name, family_name, email, and a groups claim. Custom attributes (orgUnit, costCenter) can be passed as namespaced claims and picked up by our SCIM mapping.
- Audit evidence: per your request we can provide a sample audit log export (anonymized) showing admin role changes; if you want that we'll prepare a redacted CSV.

Attachments: Halo_IAM_Questionnaire_v2_filled.xlsx (responses), redwood_scim_mapping_template.csv, admin_role_matrix.pdf, evidence_saml_oidc_summary.pdf

If you want a short 30-minute walkthrough of the mappings and the delegated admin model, Marissa is available Wed 25 Aug 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 26 Aug 14:00-14:30 PT — let us know which slot works and we'll send a calendar invite.
